name: llm-gw
changelog: v2: net:internet egress grant so upstream calls work under isolation
title: LLM Gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy. Configure a provider base URL, upstream token, and model aliases once; other tiles get a grant to call /v1/* (chat, embeddings, …) exactly like the OpenAI API. Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, etc.
